detail: User checked live 2026-10-12: binding OSC Button 1 to a vJoy 2 button the EVO R also shows lights it on both cards (the chip's vJoy half reads vJoy's real state). Working as wanted; button 30 showed only on the OSC card because only OSC binds it. No code change.
title: vJoy Viewer: show each vJoy device as one card so any source lights it
